NEW EVENTS - TREE OF LIFE SUPPLIES (SUP-01..14, draft for the owner, 2026-11-17)
Cutting tools, bars of soap and bolts of cloth in The Tree of Life: blades made, lost and found, soap that slips away or smells of flowers, and sacks for the yellow fruit. Funny, practical and warm.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: Washing day at the pond and only a few bars of soap: share one bar, or give everyone their own.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: It's washing day, and the whole village is at the pond. (subject) is standing at the edge with the soap, looking at the crowd and at the small stack of bars in the basket, and doing sums in (subject.his/her) head. (friend) wants to know what the holdup is.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The bar goes from hand to hand down the line, and everyone uses a little less than they'd like. By the end it is a sliver the size of a fingernail, and the last person in line washes with mostly hope. It is the most laughing anyone has done on washing day in years.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) hands out bar after bar. The pond turns white with foam, the children disappear into it, and the whole village comes home smelling clean. That evening, (subject) looks at the empty basket and sighs. "Worth it," says (friend).

text_only.reason: the word's everyday sense (a thing, a sound or a person out of sight for a moment); nobody leaves the village -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only
